desc: convert a PBM image into an Atari Degas .pi3 file
r: pbmtopi3 - convert a PBM image into an Atari Degas .pi3 file

This program is part of Netpbm(1).

pbmtopi3 reads a PBM image as input and produces an Atari Degas .pi3 file as output.

There are no command line options defined specifically for pbmtopi3, but it recognizes the options common to all programs based on libnetpbm (See
Common Options .)
